channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Russia detains Japanese journalist on suspicion of spying
item.description: The Hokkaido Shimbun journalist was detained in the far eastern Sakhalin region, with Moscow accusing him of collecting defense-related information.

item.title: Osaka grapples with severely aging water and sewage systems
item.description: Even if replacement work moves forward, completing it quickly is seen as nearly impossible primarily due to staffing and financial constraints.

item.title: MUFG mulling path to majority control of India’s Shriram Finance
item.description: Japan's largest bank has begun considering raising its stake in the Indian financial conglomerate to more than 50% from about 20% now, sources said.

item.title: Japanese-style schools open in Egypt, a decade after Abe struck deal
item.description: The schools, established under a 2016 agreement, incorporate Japanese school practices such as classroom cleaning and student duty rotations.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
